_label: lean description, sparse param docs (worst case)
_source: Constructed: tool description = Cell C's literal current-production lean description (unchanged). Param docs sparsified (constructed minimal one-liners, not historical text) for match_mode/follow_depth/impl_only/import_lookup/def_use/summary/git_ref. path/symbol/cursor/page_size/max_depth unchanged (not part of the rich/sparse axis).

tool.name: analyze_symbol
tool.description: Call graph for a named symbol across all files in a directory. Prefer over analyze_file when the question is "who calls X" or "what does X call" rather than "what is in this file". Modes: call graph (default), import_lookup (files importing a module path), def_use (write/read sites). Fails if file path supplied; fails if impl_only=true on non-Rust directory; fails if summary=true and cursor. match_mode controls name matching; git_ref restricts to changed files.

path.description: Directory path to search for the symbol

symbol.description: Symbol name to build call graph for (function or method). Example: `parse_config` finds all callers and callees of that function.

max_depth.description: Maximum directory traversal depth. Unset means unlimited. Use 2-3 for large monorepos.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor field. Pass unchanged to retrieve the next page. Omit on the first call.

page_size.description: Files per page for pagination (default: 100). Reduce below 100 to limit response size; increase above 100 to reduce round trips.

impl_only.description: Restrict callers to Rust trait impl blocks.

import_lookup.description: Find files importing a module path.

git_ref.description: Restrict to files changed since this git ref.

def_use.description: Extract write/read sites for the symbol.
